status: authored 2026-10-02, generated by tools/lopunny_house.py and audited offline by tools/lopunny_house_audit.py; not yet applied to any world. The Lopunny check end to end is experiments/EXP-052-lopunny-show
request: the owner, 2026-10-02, verbatim: "add a house at 6950 1360 that is a man who has a dungeon of buneary, hes obsessed with lopunny and wants one of his own"
ground_rule: Every Y is computed by tools/lopunny_house.py from tools/ground.py (the canonical heightmap, rounded). Nothing in this file is a Y. The house is seated on max(ground under its walls) + 1 (tools/shrines.py's and tools/frostpeak_camp.py's convention), the statue on max(ground under it) + 1, the cellar hangs from the house floor.

site.measured: 2026-10-02 from tools/ground.py: the owner's coordinate reads y116 (heightmap 116.29), and every column from x6920..6980, z1330..1390 reads y115..117 (a flat bench of the snowy taiga, the sub-region's paint preset snowy_taiga). tools/water_mask.py level_at: dry at the centre and the four corners of that square (sea level 62; no lake basin). Nearest authored place: Northlight (data/towns.json northlight, centre (7265, 1556)), 371 blocks south-east; its nearest building (northlight_house_10) is 315 away. The nearest authored things: the elder spruce elder_south_pine_isle_2 at (6768, 1208), 237 blocks north-west, and its three nest Habitat Blocks; nothing in data/placements.json, data/landmarks.json or data/rivers.json lies within 300 blocks. The owner's exact spot is buildable, so the house is centred on it.
site.faces_why: the door is on the south wall, on the side of Northlight (south-east) and of the yard where the statue stands

house.why: a modest one-room cottage, 11 by 11 outside and 9 by 9 inside, with walls 4 high under a steep spruce gable whose ridge runs east-west: the snowy village's timber (Northlight is a snowy village, data/placements.json northlight_house_*), the frostpeak camp's vanilla spruce. One room, lived in: a bedroll, a stove, a table, shelves, and the trapdoor to the cellar in the north-west corner.

cellar.why: the 'dungeon': a 9 by 9 room, 3 blocks of air, under the house floor and inside the house's walls. Its ceiling is the block under the house floor (the ground's own top layer on this bench) and its floor 5 below the house floor. It is reached only by a ladder down from a trapdoor in the house floor. under_fill: the generator writes solid stone for under_fill blocks under the floor, so the Habitat Block's spawn box (data/habitat_blocks.json lopunny_superfan_cellar_ward, spawn_range 4) holds no air but the cellar's, whatever natural cave the ground might have had there.

blocks.rule: vanilla 1.21.1 only, none a spawn condition in data/spawn_blocks.json (brown and red carpet are not; white, yellow, magenta, lime and light grey carpet, and every wool but white, red, pink and purple, are). No chests (tools/portals_audit.py records a chest as a Gimmighoul condition) and no beds (a bed sets a respawn point, which the blackout's checkpoints own; data/frostpeak_camp.json blocks.rule): barrels and a carpet bedroll. Buneary would sleep on a bed (Cobblemon 1.8.0 species data: behaviour.resting.willSleepOnBed true), which is a pity.
blocks.colours_why: Lopunny is brown with cream fluff at the ankles, the wrists and the base of the ears; terracotta and smooth sandstone carry the two colours without a wool or a concrete (both spawn conditions in their coloured forms).

obsession.roof_ears: two Lopunny ears on the ridge, cream at the base, brown above, splayed at the tips: the house is seen from the snowfield as a Lopunny's head

statue.why: a Lopunny ten blocks tall in the front yard, on a plinth whose sign calls it an artist's impression. He has never seen one up close.

obsession.shrine: the north wall inside: a brown, white and brown row of banners over a sign and two brown candles

buneary.why: an ACTIVATED Habitat Block in the middle of the cellar floor, disguised as the floor (mimic minecraft:stone_bricks), keeping up to 12 Buneary alive in the room: the den's pattern (data/ursaluna_cave.json teddiursa; data/habitat_blocks.json ursaluna_den_outskirts_ward), the elder nests' and Driftmouth Isle's settings. The spawner is a box of spawn_range round the block (docs/research/notes/habitat-nest-perching.md 4, ActivatedHabitatSpawning.kt), and with spawn_range 4 the box is exactly the cellar: x and z the 9 by 9 interior, y from the under-fill to the ceiling, so every place a Buneary can be put is in the room. Nothing holds a Buneary in afterwards but the walls and the closed trapdoor (the same note: no tether exists for wild spawns).

npc.why: Ellis Hopgood stands inside, in the south-west of the room by the door, clear of the trapdoor, the table and the rug, on the house floor. Placed by tools/reapply.py's R9F from data/rewards.json lopunny_superfan (npc_grant, npc_at), as the Abandoned Cut's digger is; the audit checks that npc_at is this spot.

lopunny_check.why: the dialogue cannot read a party (no compiled condition does). The party read that IS proven is the water ladder's: a Molang player_tick_pre callback under data/cobblemon/callbacks/ iterates q.player.party.pokemon, reads species.identifier, and runs a command naming q.player.username (tools/blackout_pack.py, EXP-042 runs 1-2: the owner's Lapras read as mount level 1). This pack ships a second such callback that tags the player while a Lopunny is in the party and untags them otherwise, once a second, and the conversation's 'Show him your Lopunny' option is visible only with the tag (compile_dialogue's player_tag, read with q.player.has_tag as every held-item probe is). Each piece is proven; the two together are NOT, and are experiments/EXP-052-lopunny-show.

evolution.requirement: evolutions[buneary_lopunny]: variant level_up, result lopunny, requirements [{variant friendship, amount 160}]; baseFriendship 0
evolution.the_joke: a Buneary evolves on a level up once its friendship is 160, and starts at 0. Friendship belongs to a trainer's Pokemon; a wild one has none to raise and never levels up in anyone's party. Hopgood will not put his in a ball ('they're not luggage'), so in eleven years not one has evolved, and the wild Lopunny of the isle (data/spawns.json surface.south_pine_isle.lopunny, 38-43) will not come near him.

quest.shape: talk: he explains, and asks the player to raise a Buneary and bring the Lopunny to show him. Show: the hub's 'Show him your Lopunny' option appears while one is in the party; choosing it sets lopunny_shown and he gives a Soothe Bell, once per player (grant_reward_once). Nothing is taken from the player.
